ey.name: EY
ey.avatarNotes: Huge Iona alumni base in assurance (FSO) and tax. Most of these contacts are audit/tax, so they're best for referrals into EY's Strategy & Transactions or FSO groups and for intros to friends in banking.
ey.keyDateLabel: No deadline. Alumni outreach for advice and referrals.

pwc.name: PwC
pwc.avatarNotes: Tax and audit alumni. Useful for Deals/Transaction Services referrals and for general recruiting advice.
pwc.keyDateLabel: No deadline. Alumni outreach for advice and referrals.

deloitte.name: Deloitte
deloitte.avatarNotes: Audit & assurance and tax alumni. Ask about Deloitte's financial advisory side and who they know in banking.
deloitte.keyDateLabel: No deadline. Alumni outreach for advice and referrals.

citi.name: Citi
citi.avatarNotes: Mostly branch banking alumni plus a Director at Citigroup. The Director is the one to ask for an intro into Citi's markets or banking analyst programs.
citi.keyDateLabel: No deadline. Alumni outreach for advice and referrals.

bofa.name: Bank of America
bofa.avatarNotes: An Analyst and an Operations Specialist. Ask the analyst how they recruited and which BofA summer programs take sophomores.
bofa.keyDateLabel: No deadline. Alumni outreach for advice and referrals.

pepsico.name: PepsiCo
pepsico.avatarNotes: HQ in Purchase, NY, close to Iona. Accounting, pension and data analysts. Good for corporate finance internships and as a backup path.
pepsico.keyDateLabel: No deadline. Alumni outreach for advice and referrals.

nbcu.name: NBCUniversal
nbcu.avatarNotes: NBC Sports is based in Stamford. Lower priority for finance recruiting; ask for finance-side intros.
nbcu.keyDateLabel: No deadline. Alumni outreach for advice and referrals.

iona-net.avatarNotes: Iona alumni whose current employer isn't shown in their LinkedIn headline. Message them on LinkedIn and ask for intros.

v-any-warm.subject: Fellow Gael, quick favor?
v-any-warm.hook: We're both Gaels and share a few connections.
v-any-warm.body:
Hi {first},

We're both Gaels and share a few connections, so I wanted to reach out. I'm an Iona finance sophomore (3.9 GPA) and an overnight EMT in the Stamford Hospital ER, recruiting for summer 2027 finance internships.

Would you have 10 minutes to share how you got where you are, and is there anyone you think I should talk to?

{signature}
v-any-warm.label: GENERIC · Warm intro
